arguments.prompt: Alpine ski resort Jasna and Chopok in the Low Tatras, a bright summer day in 2035. Airy, optimistic light-orchestral piece at 92 BPM, D major: plucked harp and acoustic guitar arpeggios, flute and soft horn melody, warm strings, subtle modern clean synth arpeggio shimmer, light hand percussion. Fresh mountain air, cable cars, wonder without bombast. Instrumental only, absolutely no vocals, no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir. Video game background score for a warm, gentle, humorous point-and-click adventure about a kind repairman who travels through time in Bratislava, Slovakia. Civil and friendly, never epic or dark. Steady tempo and steady texture from start to finish so it can loop: no fade-in, no fade-out, no big finale, no long silence; keep the same energy throughout, ending on the groove. Length about 2 minutes 30 seconds.
